title: What's New: Power BI Reporting for Business Central - New Apps (2024 release wave 2)

features.name: Power BI Embedded Reports
features.description: 76 Power BI reports that are embedded within Business Central, enabling access to reporting directly from the application through role centers and role explorer.
caveats: Requires setup and configuration to connect to Power BI workspace
Apps are currently per company, requiring separate setup for each company

features.name: Finance Reports
features.description: Power BI apps providing financial KPIs and balance sheet drill-through capabilities with account category setup for accurate reporting.
caveats: Requires account category mapping for financial KPIs
Setup wizard required for initial configuration

features.name: Sales Overview Reports
features.description: Power BI reports providing KPIs and details for sales activities with filtering capabilities.
caveats: Filtering and drill-through available on most reports

features.name: Power BI Setup Wizard
features.description: An assisted setup wizard that guides users through selecting calendar type, date range, holidays, and mapping Power BI workspaces to Business Central companies.
caveats: Setup can be revisited and modified after initial configuration
Users can start with one app and add more incrementally

features.name: Power BI Apps for Inventory
features.description: Inventory reporting app, with note that two different apps may be needed for complete inventory reporting.
caveats: Inventory requires two separate apps for complete functionality

features.name: Demo Data for Power BI
features.description: Enhanced demo data planned for upcoming minor releases to enable demonstration and exploration of Power BI capabilities without connecting to production environments.
features.status_evidence_quote: in one of the coming releases minor releases hopefully the second one we will add demo data
caveats: Planned for a future minor release, not in current release
Will include financial, project, and fixed assets data initially

features.name: Subscription Billing App
features.description: New Power BI app for subscription billing reporting embedded in Business Central, planned for future releases.
caveats: Not yet available, planned for later releases

features.name: Sustainability App
features.description: New Power BI app for sustainability reporting with embedded capabilities in Business Central.

features.name: Fixed Assets App
features.description: New Power BI app for fixed assets reporting with embedded capabilities in Business Central.

features.name: Open Source Power BI Files
features.description: Power BI .pbix files will be made available as open source from GitHub starting in release 26, allowing users to customize reports, add data sources, and create their own variations.
features.status_evidence_quote: from the next release which means uh release 26 which is April uh we will open source the report files
caveats: Available starting April in release 26, not current release
